_comment: Octail curated egg (plan §6.4). Based on games-steamcmd risk_of_rain_2/egg-risk-of-rain2.json (pelican-eggs, MIT licence) and avivace/ror2-server's server.cfg (MIT licence). Octail writes a first server.cfg only when there is none (upstream copied server_startup.cfg over it on every reinstall and blanked its exec and host lines, which made the server.cfg run itself) and makes sure each key it sets has a line, sets the keys with their trailing space (the file parser matches line starts, so sv_port doesn't also replace sv_password), lets Steam pick its own Steam port (steam_server_steam_port 0, as avivace's image does) instead of a second fixed port, gives the query port its own automatic port (port_vars), adds the server tags and the game mode (Classic or Simulacrum), the risk-of-rain-2, bepinex and thunderstore tags with Wine loading BepInEx's winhttp.dll first (WINEDLLOVERRIDES, as avivace's image does with mods; Octail's Thunderstore tool installs BepInExPack with the first mod), the Steam query (A2S) for player counts, install sandbox defaults and resource hints, port readiness (x_octail.features.ready) besides the start lines, starts with the image's Xvfb instead of xvfb-run, installs the Windows Steam client libraries (app 1007) with the server instead of a second SteamCMD run, drops the hidden Wine variables (the image sets them) and the Wine Mono winetricks run (the game brings its own Mono), and makes the install fail when SteamCMD didn't download the server. Since build 20243729 (2025-11) the public branch of app 1180760 has carried an empty depot (its manifest lists 0 bytes and 0 bytes to download; the server itself is a Windows x64 build: "Risk of Rain 2.exe" with "Risk of Rain 2_Data/"), so SteamCMD reports "fully installed" after seconds and installs nothing (node1, 2026-10-13): the install then prints the server folder and the app manifest and says that the server is not on Steam right now. SteamCMD is retried up to 3 times: its first run on a fresh install often fails with "Missing configuration".
name: Risk of Rain 2
author: eggs@octail.net
description: Escape a chaotic alien planet by fighting through hordes of monsters, alone or with up to three friends. The Windows dedicated server, run under Wine.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
## Octail curated install: SteamCMD downloads the Windows build of the server (it runs under Wine).
## Server Files: /mnt/server

## anonymous login: this server needs no Steam account
STEAM_USER=anonymous
STEAM_PASS=""
STEAM_AUTH=""

## download and install steamcmd (the small archive goes to /tmp, the game straight to the server's disk)
cd /tmp || exit 1
mkdir -p /mnt/server/steamcmd
curl -fsSL --connect-timeout 30 --max-time 300 --retry 3 --retry-delay 5 -o steamcmd.tar.gz https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/client/installer/steamcmd_linux.tar.gz || { echo "Downloading SteamCMD failed."; exit 1; }
tar -xzvf steamcmd.tar.gz -C /mnt/server/steamcmd
rm -f steamcmd.tar.gz
mkdir -p /mnt/server/steamapps # Fix steamcmd disk write error when this folder is missing
cd /mnt/server/steamcmd || exit 1

# SteamCMD fails otherwise for some reason, even running as root.
# This is changed at the end of the install process anyways.
chown -R root:root /mnt
export HOME=/mnt/server

## install game using steamcmd (app 1007: the Windows Steam client libraries the server loads under Wine)
## Octail: SteamCMD's first run often fails with "Missing configuration"; try up to 3 times
for steamcmd_try in 1 2 3; do
    if ./steamcmd.sh +force_install_dir /mnt/server +login ${STEAM_USER} ${STEAM_PASS} ${STEAM_AUTH} $( [[ "${WINDOWS_INSTALL}" == "1" ]] && printf %s '+@sSteamCmdForcePlatformType windows' ) +app_update 1007 +app_update ${SRCDS_APPID} $( [[ -z ${SRCDS_BETAID} ]] || printf %s "-beta ${SRCDS_BETAID}" ) $( [[ -z ${SRCDS_BETAPASS} ]] || printf %s "-betapassword ${SRCDS_BETAPASS}" ) validate +quit; then break; fi
    echo "SteamCMD did not finish (attempt $steamcmd_try of 3)"
done

## set up 32 bit libraries
mkdir -p /mnt/server/.steam/sdk32
cp -v linux32/steamclient.so ../.steam/sdk32/steamclient.so

## set up 64 bit libraries
mkdir -p /mnt/server/.steam/sdk64
cp -v linux64/steamclient.so ../.steam/sdk64/steamclient.so

## Octail: fail the install when SteamCMD didn't download the server. Since build 20243729 (2025-11) the public
## branch of app 1180760 carries an empty depot (Steam's manifest lists 0 bytes), so SteamCMD says "fully installed"
## within seconds and installs nothing: the failure shows what SteamCMD left and names that case.
if [[ ! -f "/mnt/server/Risk of Rain 2.exe" ]]; then
    echo -e "\nSteamCMD failed to install the Risk of Rain 2 dedicated server (no \"Risk of Rain 2.exe\" in the server folder)."
    echo "The server folder after SteamCMD:"
    ls -la /mnt/server
    manifest="/mnt/server/steamapps/appmanifest_${SRCDS_APPID}.acf"
    if [[ -f "$manifest" ]]; then
        grep -E '"(buildid|SizeOnDisk|StateFlags)"' "$manifest"
        if grep -qE '"SizeOnDisk"[[:space:]]+"0"' "$manifest"; then
            echo "Steam's public branch of app ${SRCDS_APPID} holds no files right now (SizeOnDisk 0): the dedicated server can't be installed until its publisher puts it back on Steam. Nothing on this server can fix that."
            exit 1
        fi
    fi
    echo "Try reinstalling."
    exit 1
fi

## Octail: the server runs server_startup.cfg, which runs server.cfg. A first server.cfg is written here; an
## existing one is kept. Every line Octail sets before each start ("key value;", the file parser matches "key ")
## must be there, so a key without a line gets one of its own.
CFG_DIR="/mnt/server/Risk of Rain 2_Data/Config"
CFG="${CFG_DIR}/server.cfg"
mkdir -p "${CFG_DIR}"
if [[ ! -f "$CFG" ]]; then
    cat > "$CFG" <<'EOF'
// Risk of Rain 2 dedicated server settings, written by the Octail install.
// The Startup tab sets the name, password, players, listing, tags, game mode and ports before every start.
sv_maxplayers 4;
steam_server_heartbeat_enabled 1;
sv_hostname "Octail Risk of Rain 2 Server";
sv_port 27015;
steam_server_query_port 27016;
steam_server_steam_port 0;
sv_password "";
sv_custom_tags "";
gamemode "ClassicRun";
EOF
fi
sed -i 's/\r$//' "$CFG"
for key in sv_maxplayers steam_server_heartbeat_enabled sv_hostname sv_port steam_server_query_port \
    steam_server_steam_port sv_password sv_custom_tags gamemode; do
    grep -qE "^${key} " "$CFG" || echo "${key} ;" >> "$CFG"
done
## the server warns at every start without it
touch "${CFG_DIR}/server_pregame.cfg"

## install end
echo "-----------------------------------------"
echo "Installation completed..."
echo "-----------------------------------------"

variables.name: Server Name
variables.description: The name in the server list (no double quotes, backslashes or semicolons).

variables.name: Server Password
variables.description: Optional: players must enter it (cl_password) to join. Empty = no password (letters, digits, - and _).

variables.name: Max Players
variables.description: How many players may join at once (the game is made for 4; more needs mods).

variables.name: Advertise Server
variables.description: List the server in the in-game server browser (1 = on, 0 = off; players can still connect by address).

variables.name: Game Mode
variables.description: ClassicRun (the normal game) or InfiniteTowerRun (Simulacrum, needs the Survivors of the Void DLC).

variables.name: Server Tags
variables.description: Optional: tags shown in the server browser, separated by commas.

variables.name: Query Port
variables.description: Steam query port (UDP), for the server list. Set by Octail when the server is created (the port after the game port).

variables.name: Auto Update
variables.description: Update the server with SteamCMD before every start (1 = on, 0 = off).

variables.name: Windows Install
variables.description: Downloads the Windows build (the server runs under Wine).
